# Straight Flush Plumbing & Leak Detection

> Family-owned, diagnose-first plumbing and leak detection company serving Laguna Niguel and South/Central Orange County, California since 2019. Slogan: "Always A Safe Bet."

Straight Flush Plumbing & Leak Detection specializes in finding hidden water leaks and slab leaks using acoustic, electronic, and thermal imaging technology — confirming the exact source of a leak before any repair, demolition, or repiping is recommended. The company is owned and operated by Lance, based at 78 Cameray Heights, Laguna Niguel, CA 92677. Phone: (949) 374-6524. Email: straightflushplumbing03@gmail.com. Rated 4.8/5 on Yelp (74 reviews) and 5.0/5 on Google.

## Core services
- [Leak Detection](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/leak-detection.html): Acoustic, electronic, and thermal detection of hidden water leaks without unnecessary demolition.
- [Slab Leak Detection](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/slab-leak-detection.html): The company's core specialty — pinpointing leaks beneath concrete foundations.
- [PEX Repiping](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/pex-repiping.html): Whole-house repiping and copper line elimination.
- [Water Heater Services](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/water-heater-services.html): Repair, replacement, and tankless conversion.
- [Drain Services](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/drain-services.html): Drain cleaning and sewer line diagnostics.
- [Plumbing Repair](https://straightflushplumbingoc.com/services/plumbing-repair.html): Faucets, toilets, pipe repair, water pressure issues.
